violated_contract: Daily lost-audio accounting must not charge a stale native outage marker for time the device was connected. A marker retained across reconnect or process restore is not a full calendar day of lost audio; real loss cannot exceed disconnected time, and a never-recovered gap still counts when the day has no connection evidence.
canonical_prevention: Do not reopen an outage from a native start once the current link has delivered audio; close markers that predate that link at the link start and leave a newer in-link gap alone. Cap emitted lost-audio seconds by the day's disconnected time. On iOS, clear the native marker when audio resumes even if the history plist write fails.
